HOW TO REACH US

Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
zweirad mechaniker

Stellenbeschreibung:
We are partnering with a fast-growing e-mobility startup to recruit a Team Lead – E-Bike Mechanics for their Berlin Refurbishment Centre.
In this role, you will lead and mentor a team of e-bike mechanics, ensuring the highest quality standards in e-bike refurbishment and repair. You’ll play a key part in ensuring operations run smoothly and efficiently while promoting a positive team culture. This is an exciting opportunity to be at the forefront of sustainable mobility in one of the most dynamic sectors.

Your Role

- Lead & Mentor: Provide hands-on guidance and training to a team of e-bike mechanics, ensuring their continuous development and high performance.
- Technical Expertise: Act as the go-to expert for complex repairs and troubleshooting, setting the benchmark for technical excellence.
- Workflow & Efficiency: Oversee day-to-day operations, optimizing processes to ensure efficiency, productivity, and adherence to timelines.
- Quality Control: Ensure that all refurbished e-bikes meet rigorous quality standards before reaching customers.
- Problem Solving & Innovation: Identify bottlenecks in operations and implement process improvements to enhance performance and customer satisfaction.
- Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with cross-functional teams (e.g., Operations, Customer Service) to streamline operations and enhance service delivery.
- Health & Safety Compliance: Ensure all safety protocols and best practices are followed, maintaining a safe and organized work environment.

Your Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in e-bike mechanics, with extensive hands-on experience.
- Previous team management experience with a proven track record of mentoring and developing team members.
- Strong diagnostic and repair skills across a wide range of e-bike brands and models.
- Excellent organizational and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Passion for sustainable mobility and a customer-first mindset.
- Basic PC skills (Email, MS Office).
- Good knowledge of English (German is a plus).
- Willingness to work in a team in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

The Offer

- High-impact role with responsibility for leading and mentoring a talented team of mechanics.
- Opportunity to work with state-of-the-art tools and diagnostic equipment in a comfortable environment.
- Career development opportunities with performance evaluations and the chance for promotion every six months.
- Work with a diverse range of e-bikes—gain expertise in different bike types, models, and brands.
- Competitive salary with benefits.
- No weekend work, providing you with a great work-life balance.
- Be part of a fast-growing startup in the sustainable e-mobility sector, with a mission-driven focus.

zweirad mechaniker

jobs.occupation: Digital Electronics Design Engineer (f/m/d) (Elektroniker/in - Luftfahrttechnische Systeme)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

- Design complex digital electronic circuits for applications such as signal processing, instrument control, and data compression
- Develop high-speed digital electronics, including multi-gigabit serial links and high-speed memory-to-FPGA interfaces
- Verify circuit performance through simulation, including worst-case analysis, derating, and signal integrity analysis
- Supervise PCB layout activities for multilayer and rigid-flex high-reliability PCBs
- Test and validate your circuits in the laboratory as well as under extreme conditions during qualification and acceptance testing
- Collaborate closely with other engineering disciplines, including mechanical design, radiation engineering, EEE engineering, manufacturing, and FPGA/IP core design
Your Qualifications

- Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering or a comparable discipline
- At least 5 years of professional experience in the design of digital electronics hardware, including FPGAs, microcontrollers, and high-speed digital interface standards such as JESD204, DDR memory, PCI, or Wizard Link, ideally in the space industry
- Experience in electronics design in accordance with applicable ECSS standards
- Knowledge of spacecraft communication interface standards such as SpaceWire, MIL-STD-1553, and SpaceFibre
- Experience with at least one programming language suitable for controlling automated test setups, such as Python or C/C++
- Experience with ECAD design and simulation tools, e.g. Siemens PADS Professional, Xpedition, Spice, or HyperLynx
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Your Tasks

- Manage / Support the preparation of proposals; inter alia (depending on the specific proposal, the candidate will have to either take full responsibility or only support the different tasks):
- Lead the proposal team towards the delivery of a proposals, on quality, time and cost
- Ensure that the proposal properly answer to the customer requirements; both formal requirements (conditions of tender, technical, programmatic, financial requirements, etc) and unofficial customer needs (technical, programmatic, financial, contractual, industrial, political, etc)
- Ensure that the proposal passes all the required reviews (content and cost) and that expectations of all internal stakeholders are reflected
The candidate shall expect to face proposals of a large variety, in terms of contract value, vertical (EO, Navigation, Exploration, Telecom, Space Transportation, etc.) and customers (ESA, EC, DLR, other agencies, BW, commercial entities, etc.).
- Contribute to the organization and execution of in-house trainings on the proposal process
- Contribute to the maintenance of proposal-related key performance indicators, evaluation of proposal statistics and support of definition of measures (in co-ordination with department lead)
- Support the improvement of proposal processes, proposal quality and thus likelihood of proposal success
Your Qualifications

- Hard requirements:
- Completed studies (Diploma or Master) in aerospace engineering or equivalent qualification (i.e. mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, physics)
- Strategic acting: Entrepreneurial thinking and acting with strong emphasis on quality and cost
- Strong experience in proposals management (3 years +) with Institutional customers
- Advanced knowledge of the MS suite (VBA coding, high-level skills with MS Word) and of advanced editing tools (Adobe, InDesign)
- Very good communication skills in oral and written English
- Additional competences considered strong assets:
- Experience in cost engineering
- Experience in the space sector; commercial space sector as a plus
- Background in system engineering and project management
- Knowledge of German; any other European language as plus

jobs.occupation: Early Years Educator / Pädagogische Fachkraft Kindergarten englischsprachig (m/w/d) (Erzieher/in)
jobs.description:
Early Years Educator / English-speaking Kindergarten Teacher (m/w/d)
Full-time or part-time | Munich Alt-Bogenhausen

Phorms Campus Munich is a bilingual German-English education campus offering educational programmes from Crèche and Kindergarten through Primary School to Secondary School. Our well-located and lovingly maintained city campus in Munich Alt-Bogenhausen, close to the English Garden, is home to an international school community where children, families and staff feel welcome, supported and valued.

In our bilingual Kindergarten and Crèche, we encourage children to try out new things, respect themselves and others, develop empathy and curiosity, and grow in confidence and independence. In this way, we build a strong foundation for their future education.

For our Kindergarten and Crèche in Munich Alt-Bogenhausen, we are looking for a motivated and qualified Early Years Educator / English-speaking Kindergarten Teacher (all genders) in full-time or part-time.

Your Responsibilities

• Supporting and fostering children in their individual development according to our Early Childhood curriculum
• Creating a warm, safe and stimulating learning environment for children in Crèche and Kindergarten
• Observing, assessing and documenting children’s learning journeys and developmental progress
• Planning and implementing age-appropriate educational activities
• Working closely with parents in a professional and trust-based parent-teacher partnership
• Bringing your own interests, strengths and creative ideas into the daily life of the Kindergarten
• Collaborating respectfully and supportively with colleagues in a bilingual and international team

Your Profile

• Completed qualification or degree in Early Childhood Education, Early Years Education, Childcare, Pedagogy, Social Pedagogy or a comparable field
• Ideally recognised as a qualified early years professional in Bavaria, or willingness to have your qualification checked for recognition
• Professional experience in early childhood education is an advantage
• Excellent English skills at native or near-native level, as you will work as an English-speaking reference person within our bilingual concept
• German language skills are not mandatory at the start
• Willingness and motivation to learn German and develop your language skills over time
• Enjoyment of working with children in Crèche and Kindergarten age groups
• Interest in working in a bilingual and international educational environment
• Team spirit, reliability, responsibility, empathy and motivation
• Valid work permit for Germany, EU citizenship or a residence title allowing employment in Germany

Our Benefits

• Attractive and competitive remuneration package                                                                                                   • Annual special payment of up to €1,500 gross, depending on working hours                                                    • Additional employer benefits, for example public transport pass or Edenred City Card
• Free healthy lunch
• Subsidised EGYM Wellpass membership
• Comprehensive company pension scheme
• Relocation support for work-related moves
• Corporate Benefits Portal
• 34 days of annual leave
• Regular working hours and long-term shift planning for better work-life balance
• Dedicated preparation and planning time, both individually and within the team
• Regular staff meetings during working hours
• Wide range of professional development and training opportunities
• Support in learning German through language courses and everyday practice in an international environment
• Attractively furnished group rooms, children’s kitchen, well-equipped gymnastics room, extensive library and generous outdoor area
• Modern digital equipment, including iPads and smart displays in preschool
• Bilingual teaching teams with up to three qualified pedagogical team members per group
• Support from additional teaching and administrative staff, including music and sports teachers
• Age-oriented groups with dedicated preschool classes
• A warm, international team on a beautiful campus close to the English Garden

Please note

For this position, a relevant early years qualification is required. Applications from international professionals are welcome, provided that a valid work permit for Germany is in place or can be obtained. For qualifications obtained outside Germany, recognition as a qualified early years professional in Bavaria should already be available or be possible to assess.

German language skills are not required at the beginning. However, we are looking for candidates who are motivated to learn German and willing to develop their language skills while working in our international environment.

Would you like to support children in a bilingual, international Kindergarten and bring your English language skills into meaningful early years education? Then we look forward to receiving your application via our website.

Further information can be found at: https://www.phorms.de/en/career/munich/ (https://www.phorms.de/en/career/munich/) .
If you have any questions, please contact Katharina: careers@phorms.de (https://mailto:careers@phorms.de)

jobs.employer_name: SOFHA GmbH Gesellschaft für Soft- und Hardware
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

- Creation and processing of test plans, test files and test scripts according to software function specifications
- Statement of test results in the agile software development management tool “Jira” in English
- Setup and configuration of virtual machines containing Windows- and Macintosh-Systems as test platforms
- Setup and configuration of software and hardware simulators of digital print equipment
- Performing print tests out of various applications and operating digital printers.

Your Profile

- Good knowledge of operating PC and/or Macintosh systems
- Firm with commonly used desktop software and office applications (Microsoft365, Adobe Acrobat, Photoshop, Illustrator)
- Good command of the English language
- Preferably IT specialist/technician or equal work experiences in the field of quality assurance of software products
- Preferably a working knowledge of network components, network protocols and client-server-systems
- Preferably a working knowledge of a commonly used scripting language (PowerShell, Bash, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python)
- Preferably with work experiences in the field of automated testing of software products

.Note: This is an onsite Berlin based position.

Your Tasks

Are you passionate about everything related to cloud engineering? Are you motivated to build our private on-premises Kubernetes cloud platform on bare-metal servers with over 85,000 CPU cores, servicing our more than 42 million users? Do you want to join us in developing this infrastructure, which is now one of the largest private Kubernetes clouds in the world? Then join our team.

- Continuously expand and optimize our infrastructure in collaboration with your colleagues.
- Further develop and maintain our Kubernetes platform - help us make our 500+ cloud-native services even better.
- Automate build and deployment processes with continuous integration.
- Develop our own Kubernetes operators and extend our platform with features such as persistent storage, GPUs, and service mesh technology (Istio).
- Work on open source projects and be part of a rotating 24/7 on-call team.

Your Profile

Do you have a degree in technical studies or a comparable education? Are you familiar with Kubernetes, Python, Prometheus, Puppet, and GitLab CI in a highly scalable, high-traffic environment? Are you passionate about automation and complex tech stacks? Are you a software developer with a high affinity for operations or an operations engineer? Then we are looking forward to your application!

- You have several years of experience with Kubernetes and Docker, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and corresponding tools.
- You have strong skills in using Linux and good knowledge of BASH, Python, and/or Go.
- You are very familiar with GIT workflows and feature branches, merge/pull requests, etc.
- You are motivated to learn new things, and your motto is: "Together we are stronger."
- Communication is important to you; you’re fluent in English and preferably also have German skills.

Our Benefits

🏢Lived corporate culture: Flat hierarchies, a culture of respect and appreciation, signatories of the Diversity Charter, open communication, and no dress code.

🎓Wide range of further training: Internal and external training opportunities, LinkedIn Learning, language courses, talent development programs, conferences, and mentoring.

💡 TEC-Campus: Free choice between Linux, Mac, or Windows, slack days, conferences, lecture series, courses, open-source projects, community meetups, and user groups.

❤️ Active health care: Wellpass, health days, family & care support services, discounts at fitness centers, mental health first responder, fresh fruit and drinks for free.

🚝Mobility: Subsidy for job bike leasing, job ticket, and relocation service if you live outside Germany.

💻Flexible working models: Home office options, flexible working hours, and 30 days of vacation with the option for additional unpaid leave.

💰Financial benefits: Corporate benefits, company pension scheme, capital-forming benefits, occupational disability insurance, and various partner discounts.

🎉 Events: Summer and winter parties, sports tournaments, and team events.

Phorms Education currently runs five bilingual, German-English nurseries within Heilbronn and the surrounding area as part of a cooperation with the Schwarz Group. Early Childhood Educator

(in part-time or full-time)

Our Benefits

- An attractive salary with additional benefits (e.g. company pension scheme, monthly public transport ticket and free, freshly prepared lunch that changes daily)
- A relocation allowance and all paperwork completed and prepared for residency and work permits
- Continuing professional development opportunities
- Open concept with individual support for each child
- Innovative educational concepts and state of the art educational resources
- Short-term provision of employee housing at current market prices for a relaxed arrival

Your Responsibilities  

- Holistic support of our children in the cognitive, emotional, and creative areas
- Preparation and follow-up as well as implementation of parent meetings
- Regular observation of the holistic development and abilities of kindergarten children

- Certified training as an early childhood educator, a degree in education or comparable education that enables you to work as a specialist or supplementary staff member by the respective local authorities
- Identify with our pedagogical concept and are motivated to creatively implement it collaboratively as a team
- Motivated to co-create new pedagogical methodologies to continuously develop with the organisation
- Interest in working in a bilingual and international atmosphere
- Motivated and committed to working as part of a team
- Fluent English skills and German language skills at least level B2

Interested in re-shaping education? Bring your new ideas to life with us and apply now via our website (https://www.phorms.de/en/career/jobs/job/early-childhood-educator/?utm_source=afa&utm_medium=jobanzweb&utm_campaign=BaW%C3%BC_KiTa_Early_Childhood_Educator_engl_0521) .

Please visit jobs.phorms.de (https://www.phorms.de/en/career/overview/)  for more details and do not hesitate to contact Carolin and Lisa, via careers@phorms.de (https://mailto:careers@phorms.de) .

We look forward to your application!

About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

DOA Management Engineer (d/f/m)

We are looking for a DOA Management Engineer (d/f/m) to join our team and support the management and coordination of activities related to the Design Organisation Approvals (DOAs) in Airbus Defence and Space GmbH.

You will be responsible for managing approval processes within the Design Organisation, ensuring that the relevant manuals, procedures and documentation are properly maintained, updated and implemented in accordance with applicable requirements.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Manage approval processes and ensure compliance with applicable aviation regulations, airworthiness standards, and organisational requirements
- Support DOA Management in ensuring compliance with applicable aviation regulations and organisational requirements.
- Act as a central point of coordination between DOA Management, internal Design Organisation departments, and National Airworthiness Authorities.
- Coordinate the preparation, review, approval, and implementation of DOA manuals, procedures, and controlled documentation.
- Monitor approval statuses to ensure key actions and deliverables are completed within designated timeframes.
- Support the implementation of structural changes to Design Organisation procedures and systems.
- Facilitate proactive communication and alignment across stakeholders.
- Participate in internal reviews, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives related to the DOA system.
- Maintain rigorous document control and ensure full traceability across all records.

jobs.description:
The research group for the Topology of Correlated Systems at the TUM Center for Quantum Engineering (ZQE) and the Department of Physics is looking for a postdoctoral researcher (f/m/d) to join the BMFTR-funded collaborative project “GarliQ - Green Advanced Refrigerants: Light-element oxides & intermetallics for Quantum cooling” at the earliest possible date. The position is initially limited to 3 years, full-time.

GarliQ is a collaborative project between TUM and kiutra GmbH, funded under the BMFTR call “Enabling Technologies for Resilient R&D Supply Chains in Quantum Technologies”. The project aims to develop new materials with magnetocaloric properties for use as cooling media in adiabatic demagnetization refrigeration (ADR) systems in the millikelvin temperature range - key components of the cryogenic infrastructure for quantum technologies.

Independent synthesis of magnetocaloric material systems (oxide and intermetallic compounds) via solid-state synthesis and melt crystal growth
Structural characterization of the synthesized materials, including by X-ray diffraction
Investigation of magnetic and thermodynamic low-temperature properties using standard and dilution refrigerator cryostats; as applicable, experiments at neutron and synchrotron sources
Determination of magnetocaloric parameters (isothermal entropy change, adiabatic temperature change)
Scale-up of promising synthesis routes for integration into ADR cooling systems, in close coordination with the industrial project partner kiutra GmbH
Supervision of PhD students, master's students, and student assistants within the project
Writing scientific publications for peer-reviewed journals
Presentation of results at national and international conferences

Completed doctorate in physics, materials science, chemistry, or a related field
Solid experience in the synthesis of inorganic solids
Knowledge of structural characterization (powder X-ray diffraction, Laue diffraction, microscopy, …)
Experience with magnetic and thermodynamic measurements (magnetometry, susceptibility, heat capacity, …) at low and ultra-low temperatures
Experience operating crystal growth facilities and/or cryostats
Demonstrated publication record in solid-state physics or materials science
Independent, structured way of working and enjoyment of interdisciplinary teamwork
Excellent written and spoken English; knowledge of German is an advantage
Experience supervising students is an advantage
We offer the opportunity to contribute to an internationally visible research topic at the interface of solid-state physics and quantum technologies - in an excellently equipped low-temperature laboratory at the TUM Department of Physics and in close collaboration with an innovative industry partner.
TUM offers a working environment with flexible working hours, flat hierarchies, and open communication, as well as a comprehensive, free range of professional and personal development opportunities.
Remuneration is based on qualifications according to TV-L. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women in its workforce; applications from women are therefore explicitly encouraged.
